pairs.why: The two cameras are nearly identical: both have the same black leather-grain body, chrome flash and lens, and the same lighting, so neither is clearly closer to the softer, more colorful real cards.
A and B differ only slightly in lens size and placement, and both share the same textured black body and statue-like chrome finish.
The two are almost the same render, so nothing in rendering, color or construction separates them.
B's lens catches a slightly brighter blue reflection, which comes a little closer to the colorful lenses on the real cards, but the bodies are equally grainy.
Both shields have the same gold rim, silver plate and embossed house, with only small differences in bevel and highlights.
B's rim is a little chunkier and its plate has a stronger glare, while A's plate is a little more beveled; neither moves clearly toward the real cards' saturated, toy-like finish.
The two drawings are nearly identical in shape, material and light.
B's slightly thicker, softer gold rim reads a little more toy-like, like the real cards, but the difference is marginal.
